messages:
Ari: Quick sync: Microcohort B (10 seats) goes live 5/12-5/14. Objective: fast validation on SSO + embeddings pipeline. Need owner for: kickoff invites, sandbox creds, two-week post-checkup, and renewal-risk tagging in SFDC.

Priya: Ian own sandbox creds + onboarding doc updates. Will generate per-tenant API keys and a short howto (rotate, scopes). Will need AM list to scope keys.

Diego: Ian do kickoff invites and walk-through. Suggest 20m demo + 10m Q&A slots. Should we offer an optional deep-dive for infra folks? :thinking_face: 

Tess: Yes please. Also recommend we include a brief checklist in the invite: 1) confirm SSO, 2) run sample query, 3) check embeddings upload. That reduces back-and-forth.

Connor: Ops-bot created a tracking sheet: https://drive.redwood/microB-onboard. I added columns: AM, SSO-needed, API-rotation, Priority, Next-check.

Ari: Nice. Priya pls attach the key rotation snippet. Diego pls draft the invite. Tess pls draft checklist blurb. Connor pls wire automation to set SFDC tag when Next-check > 7 days no-touch.

Priya: Key rotation snippet (to include in doc):
```
# rotate key
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/keys/rotate -H "Authorization: Bearer <admin>" -d '{"tenant_id":"<TENANT>","reason":"preview"}'
```
I
lso plan to post a postman collection.

Diego: Draft invite:
"""
Subject: Redwood microcohort B  Kickoff (20m demo + 10m Q&A)
Hi <Name>,
Thanks for joining our microcohort. Please pick a kickoff slot: <cal link>. Weover SSO, sample ingestion, and key rotation. If infra wants a deep-dive, pick the "infra" checkbox. Post-demo youill a 3-question survey.
Best,
Diego (CS)
"""

Tess: Checklist blurb (1-liner to paste into invite):
- Confirm SSO metadata & test login
- Upload sample embed vectors (5-10 rows)
- Run sample query and record latency

Connor: Ops-bot: SFDC tag automation set: if no contact activity within 7 days after kickoff -> set "preview:at-risk". Also posting a Slack alert to #customer-success when tag flips.

Ari: Good. We need survey q's asap. Keep it tiny. Also want an early-warning scorecard: engagement, infra blockers, perf regressions. Priya can you include a telemetry consent line in the key email?

Priya: Adding consent line: "By using these preview credentials you consent to collection of aggregated telemetry for product improvement. No PII exported." Will embed in credential email.

Diego: Proposed survey (3): 1) How confident are you to go to production (1-5)? 2) Any blocker that prevents progress? 3) Would you like a follow-up deeper technical session? Link: https://forms.gle/microB-feedback

Tess: Early-warning score thresholds I suggest: engagement < 40% -> yellow; missed first office-hour -> yellow; failed sample ingestion -> red; avg query latency +25% over baseline -> red.

Connor: Added a sheet tab "scorecard" and mapping to SFDC fields. Also integrated a webhook that posts a DM to assigned AM when a customer hits red.

Ari: Perfect. Final ask: can we have invites out by EOD tomorrow? Also schedule a 15m check-in 48-72 hours after each kickoff.

Diego: Ian send invites tonight. Will include the checklist and infra checkbox.

Priya: Sandbox creds prepared template ready. Will send per-tenant email once invites confirmed.

Tess: Office hours scheduled: Mon 10:00 PT, Tue 9:00 PT. I
dded a Zoom link to the drive.

ops-bot: Calendar events created: Microcohort B Kickoffs 5/12-5/14 (10 slots). Tracking sheet updated.

Ari: Thanks team. Follow-up: 5/10 11:00 PT quick sync to confirm invites + SFDC automation. If anything urgent DM me. :white_check_mark:
